say:1:1035808001:1.text: Judging from the sudden appearance of the golems, this was all an accident. A very coincidental accident... aimed directly at the temple.
say:1:1035808001:1.source_cn: 以魔偶表现出的状态来看，这更像是一场意外。非常巧合、针...
say:1:1035808001:1.male: Judging from the sudden appearance of the golems, this was all an accident. A very coincidental accident... aimed directly at the temple.
say:1:1035808001:1.female: Judging from the sudden appearance of the golems, this was all an accident. A very coincidental accident... aimed directly at the temple.

say:2:1035808002:1.text: This coincidence is precisely why we think someone may have been behind it.
say:2:1035808002:1.source_cn: 但也正是因为这种巧合，才更让人怀疑幕后黑手的存在。
say:2:1035808002:1.male: This coincidence is precisely why we think someone may have been behind it.
say:2:1035808002:1.female: This coincidence is precisely why we think someone may have been behind it.
